_comment: Demonstrates the `unlock` field, which the base game ships on every reader but never uses (all base readers are unlocked from the first launch — see autoload/Profile.gd). This reader stays locked until you have finished two runs. A condition is {stat, at_least} or {stat, includes}; `text` is what the player is told, and is a translation key like any other UI string. Drop `text` and Profile derives a plainer line from the condition.

readers.name: The Lantern Keeper
readers.line: You keep the light on for people who are not coming back.
readers.rule: Fire restores +1, and your first card restores +2.
